query: University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers index reading

results.content:
Consumer sentiment fell 6.3% in August in the final reading from the University of Michigan Surveys of Consumers, with the Index of Consumer Sentiment landing at 51.7, down from 55.2 in July and 11.2% below the 58.2 recorded in August 2025. The final figure was revised up from the preliminary August reading of 51.0 released Aug. 14, but the decline ends two consecutive months of improvement.

## Key Takeaways

The University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index final reading fell to 51.7 in August, a 6.3% decrease from July.

Joanne Hsu, the director of surveys, made the following comments: [...] Consumer sentiment falls in August after two previous months of improvement. The final August reading for the University of Michigan Consumer Sentiment Index came in at 51.7. This marks a 6.3% (3.5 points) decrease from July and below the preliminary reading of 51.0. Consumer sentiment sits 11.2% below where it was a year ago and is currently below the 1st percentile in the series' history.

results.content:
The University of Michigan updated its consumer sentiment index Friday with a preliminary August reading of 51, down about 8% from the final July index reading of 55.2.

The final August consumer sentiment index will be released on the 28th.

The school’s consumer sentiment tracker goes back decades and hit an all-time low in May. It had shown improvement across June and July before the downturn this month. [...] View PDF

The University of Michigan researchers collect nationwide surveys each month – asking people about business conditions, buying conditions, and personal finances – and use the feedback to calculate a consumer sentiment index.
